x: Kay (Tipton H ) and Cotterell (3rd Signals) second and third. Our own team gave its supporters who, as usual, attended in good numbers, little to enthuse about, as only four finished the course
Handicap and our team was placed fifth in the two miles Team Race. Quite a good performance considering that the field contained two Birchfield teams, who were beaten by Cotterell!, R.
Meanwhile, news comes from Egypt that Dan has recently won the Egyptian Command Championship, upon which we most heartily congratulate him. An old friend in Cotterell was second.

It was a pleasure also to see Sgt. Cotterell, the ex-Southern champion and English International, turning out for the Aldershot boys and they should gain much useful advice from such an experienced performer.
